startUrl.title: NIH RePORTER search URL
startUrl.description: Optional shortcut: build the search on reporter.nih.gov, then paste the address bar here — e.g. "https://reporter.nih.gov/search/FIJedD1bG0epAlP7QhG9lw/projects". Any tab of a shared search works (/projects, /charts, /publications …); a bare search id works too. NIH resolves the saved search on its side, so it REPLACES every filter field below (keyword, fiscal years, ICs, activity codes, org, PI, amounts, project numbers) — the run log names any you left set. Max results, abstract/publication options and the watch label still apply. Note: NIH does not promise a shared link lives forever; if it stops resolving, the run fails with a clear message and you can paste a fresh one.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Full-text search across project title, abstract and NIH indexing terms (e.g. "CRISPR", "alzheimer", "mRNA vaccine"). Leave empty to return everything matching the other filters.

fiscalYears.title: Fiscal years
fiscalYears.description: NIH fiscal years to include, e.g. 2024, 2025. A project appears once per fiscal year it was funded in. Leave empty for all years (1985 onwards).

agencyIcCodes.title: NIH Institute / Center (IC)
agencyIcCodes.description: Administering institute abbreviations: NCI, NIAID, NHLBI, NIGMS, NIDDK, NINDS, NIMH, NIA, NICHD, NIDA, NIAMS, NEI, NIEHS, NIDCD, NIDCR, NIAAA, NIBIB, NHGRI, NIMHD, NINR, NLM, NCATS, NCCIH, FIC, OD, CC, CIT, CSR, NIOSH, plus AHRQ, CDC, FDA, HRSA, SAMHSA, ACF, ACL, ASPR, VA, OASH. Leave empty for all.

activityCodes.title: Activity codes
activityCodes.description: NIH activity (award mechanism) codes, e.g. R01, R21, R43, F32, K99, U54, P01, N01. Leave empty for all.

awardTypes.title: Award types
awardTypes.description: Application type code: 1 = new, 2 = competing renewal, 3 = supplement, 4 = competing extension, 5 = non-competing continuation, 7 = change of institution, 9 = change of NIH institute.

orgNames.title: Organization names
orgNames.description: Funded organizations, e.g. "Stanford University", "Moderna". Partial names match.

orgStates.title: Organization states
orgStates.description: Two-letter US state codes of the funded organization, e.g. CA, MA, NY.

piNames.title: Principal investigator names
piNames.description: Match projects whose PI name contains any of these strings, e.g. "Doudna".

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only projects whose award amount is at least this many dollars. Caveat: NIH RePORTER applies amount filtering as a range, so using either amount field excludes projects with no award amount recorded (~3% of rows in a measured FY2024 sample).

maxAwardAmount.title: Maximum award amount (USD)
maxAwardAmount.description: Only projects whose award amount is at most this many dollars. Can be combined with the minimum for an exact band (e.g. 100000-500000). Same no-award-amount caveat as the minimum field.

projectNums.title: Project numbers (exact lookup)
projectNums.description: Look up specific projects by full project number (5R01CA234538-06) or core number (R01CA234538). When set, EVERY other filter is ignored, so a keyword or fiscal-year filter can never silently hide the project you asked for by number.

activeOnly.title: Active projects only
activeOnly.description: Only projects that are currently active (within their project period).

newlyAddedOnly.title: Newly added projects only
newlyAddedOnly.description: Only projects NIH RePORTER has added to the index recently — use this for cheap incremental pulls instead of re-scanning a whole fiscal year. Measured 2026-09-11: ~8.9k projects index-wide, almost all FY2026.

watchLabel.title: Watch label (only new since last run)
watchLabel.description: Optional. Give this saved query a name (e.g. "crispr-nci-weekly") to turn on watch mode: the Actor remembers which projects it has already delivered under that name and returns ONLY projects that are new since the previous run. The first run on a new label is a free baseline run — it records what already matches and returns zero results; every run after that returns and charges for new projects only. Change any other filter and the label starts a fresh baseline, so "new" always means new for the exact query you are watching. Leave empty for a normal one-off search.

watchChanges.title: Also alert on project changes
watchChanges.description: Only used with Watch label. When on, a project you were already alerted on is re-delivered (charged again) if its project end date, budget end date, award amount or active flag changes since you last saw it -- e.g. a no-cost extension pushing the end date out, an administrative supplement changing the award amount, or the project ending (active -> inactive). Tagged with _watchChangeType and _watchPrevious showing exactly what moved. Off by default, so a plain watchLabel only ever alerts on brand-new projects, same as before this option existed.

excludeSubprojects.title: Exclude subprojects
excludeSubprojects.description: Exclude subproject records of multi-component awards (P01/U54 centers), which otherwise duplicate their parent project.

includePublications.title: Include linked PubMed publications
includePublications.description: Join each project to the PubMed papers it produced (PMIDs + count) via NIH RePORTER's publications endpoint. Batched, so it costs roughly one extra request per 25 projects.

includeAbstract.title: Include abstract text
includeAbstract.description: Include the full project abstract and public-health-relevance statement. Turn off for a smaller dataset.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many project records. You are charged per result returned.
